# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want epic #136 and everything under it audited, so that "Vercel Frontend & 1-Click Cloud Orchestration" is accurate and test-backed

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** epic #136 and every story and task under it audited
**So that** "Vercel Frontend & 1-Click Cloud Orchestration" describes what was actually built, and every criterion is backed by a test or a re-runnable command

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [ ] Given epic #136, when audited in epic mode, then it matches the epic
      template, meets the writing standard, and its native sub-issue links are
      complete and correct
- [ ] Given story #137 and its 4 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#300)
- [ ] Given story #142 and its 3 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#301)
- [ ] Given story #146 and its 3 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#302)
- [ ] Given story #156 and its 3 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#303)
- [ ] Given story #160 and no tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#304)
- [ ] Given every criterion in this subtree, when it is read, then it names a
      test, a CI step, or a re-runnable command, and none closes on a date
      (`audit-check.py <epic> --tree` reports none)
- [ ] Given every issue in this subtree, when its metadata is read, then it has
      one type label, one priority label, no `sprint-N` label, and a correct
      native parent link (`audit-check.py <epic> --tree`)
- [ ] Given every child story is audited, when epic #136 is checked, then it
      is closed if all its stories are closed, and left open otherwise

## Definition of Ready
- [ ] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 8

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)

## Notes
Scope: epic #136, its 5 stories, and the 13 tasks under them.

Method is `/audit-artifacts`: epic mode for the epic body, story mode for each
child story. One audit task per story under review.
